svg.title: And so much more... — Callout Studio
svg.desc: Six Callout Studio features in two columns beneath the single-line headline And so much more...: Find callouts, saved color palettes, Quick insert, custom shortcuts, autocomplete, and right-click menu. Tall tiles with centered headings and uniformly enlarged components leave balanced outer margins. Original desktop component illustrations use synthetic data; the ribbon, keyboard shortcut and context menu retain their desktop appearance.
